scope: Filter bar + hero, and the bands around them. Reference taste: pinterest.com.json (homepage hero measured 2026-11-21)

colors.value: text colour on inverse (#FFFFFF dark / #000000 light)

reference_pinterest.heading: 48px/900, -0.5px, 52.8px line-height, left-aligned, 2 lines
reference_pinterest.collage: 522x450px, 6 tiles, 2.2x size range, 2 tiles bleed off top

target.layout: two columns on the 91px/1335px content edges
target.collage: 6 real covers, one anchor, overlap, 2 bleed edges
target.buttons: Browse the shelf (red) + Surprise me (grey), 48px, 16px radius

taste.name: One column edge from top bar to last tile
taste.trigger: When a sticky header, filter bar and masonry stack vertically
taste.decision: Chose one shared left/right edge (the masonry width) over a full-bleed top bar above a centred content column
taste.reason: Because the eye runs down a shared edge; a 75px jog between bands reads as an accident

taste.name: One control height per strip
taste.trigger: When chips, segment buttons, sort and arrows share a bar
taste.decision: Chose 40px for every control with aligned centres over per-control sizing
taste.reason: Because a shared height and centre line make separate parts read as one toolbar
evidence: two rows with centres at 116px and 172px

taste.name: Only show filters that can narrow the list
taste.trigger: When every book has the same status
taste.decision: Chose to remove the status control and the per-tile Read badge over keeping them for completeness
taste.reason: Because a filter that cannot change the result and a badge on every tile are noise people learn to skip

taste.name: One sticky row, not two
taste.trigger: When a filter bar stays pinned over a tall masonry feed
taste.decision: Chose genres and sort in one 64px row over a two-row 124px block
taste.reason: Because pinned height is taken from every screenful of covers, and covers are what people came to see

taste.name: Let the shelf introduce itself
taste.trigger: When the hero is the first thing on a site made of book covers
taste.decision: Chose a collage of 6 real covers from the shelf over a headline-only banner
taste.reason: Because people judge in one glance whether a shelf matches their taste, and covers say that faster than any tagline
evidence: Pinterest gives 46% of its hero width to a 6-tile collage

taste.name: One left edge from the headline down
taste.trigger: When the hero sits above a left-aligned feed
taste.decision: Chose a left-aligned text column on the 91px content edge over centred text
taste.reason: Because a centred island breaks the line people follow down the page; a shared edge carries them into the books
evidence: Pinterest heading at x=143, its container edge

taste.name: Composed, not gridded
taste.trigger: When arranging several images in a small space
taste.decision: Chose overlapping covers at five sizes with one anchor and two bleeding off the frame over an evenly spaced row
taste.reason: Because an even row reads like a shop shelf; an off-balance cluster reads like a desk mid-reading
evidence: 2 of 6 Pinterest tiles bleed off the top

taste.name: Quiet facts, loud verb
taste.trigger: When the hero has numbers and actions competing
taste.decision: Chose stats as one 14px text line, red only on Browse the shelf and grey on Surprise me, over four boxed stat pills
taste.reason: Because boxed pills look like buttons and pull clicks; plain text informs without competing with the action
